xwikidoc.title: Content Expiry warning email
xwikidoc.content:
This is the warning email that ships with the extension. Do not edit it here: every import of a new version replaces this page. Make your own copy from Administration, Content expiry, Warning email, and edit that.
Variables for the subject and the body: ##$recipientName##, ##$count##, ##$wikiName##, ##$wikiUrl##, ##$myPagesUrl##, ##$mode## (warn or delete), ##$retentionMonths## and the list ##$items##. Each item has ##title##, ##url##, ##lastModifiedText##, ##expiryText##, ##deleteOnText##, ##daysLeft##, ##threshold## and ##contactSource##.

property.subject: #if ($count == 1)A page on $wikiName is due to expire#{else}$count pages on $wikiName are due to expire#end
